```java
+   * @param capacity the total size of all sub-queues
+   * Notes: Each sub-queue has a capacity of `capacity / numSubqueues`.
+   * The first or the highest priority sub-queue has an excess capacity
+   * of `capacity % numSubqueues`
```
Reason:
The patch corrects the documentation to clarify that `capacity` refers to the total size of all sub-queues, not just a single sub-queue. It also explains how the total capacity is distributed among the sub-queues, ensuring that the implementation correctly limits the size of the call queue to the intended maximum capacity. This prevents the queue from growing larger than configured, addressing the root cause of the bug.
